reviewed.note: Baseline: changes before this date were not tracked.

unmapped.heat: The myPyllant API reports generated heat only as energy counters, no live heat output.
unmapped.return: The myPyllant API has no return temperature.
unmapped.volume: The myPyllant API has no flow rate.
unmapped.hc_return: The myPyllant API reports per circuit the flow temperature, its setpoint, the state and the heating curve, no return.
unmapped.hc_pump: The myPyllant API has no pump state per circuit.
